intuition: The i-th query needs the i-th best location among everything added so far, even when new locations arrive between queries.

brute_force.approach: Keep all locations and sort them by score descending and name ascending for every get.
brute_force.time: add O(1), get O(n log n)

optimal.approach: Maintain two heaps: the best q queried locations with their worst at the top, and all remaining locations with their best at the top. Rebalance after each add.
optimal.time: add O(log n), get O(log n)

edge_cases: Equal scores rank the lexicographically smaller name first.
A new location may outrank a previously returned location and must move across the heap boundary.
